_comment: Unit Sync client behaviour contract for SP2/SP3 (plans/04-sync-client-contract.md). Android and iOS tests load this file and must agree with it. relayLimitsDependencies must equal testdata/sync_protocol_v3.json relayLimits; a test on each platform checks that and the invariants below. Generated by testdata/tools/gen_sync_client_behaviour.py (run with --check in CI); change constants there and regenerate, never edit this file by hand.

invariants.name: everyRelayCloseCodeHasARow
invariants.check: every relayLimits.closeCodes key is in closeCodeActions

invariants.name: everyUpgradeStatusHasARow
invariants.check: every relayLimits.upgradeStatus key is in httpStatusActions

invariants.name: everyNackCodeHasARow
invariants.check: every relayLimits.opNackCodes key is in opNackActions

outboundSize.how: build the exact inner JSON with a signature placeholder of the real length (86 base64url chars), ctChars = 4*ceil((innerUtf8Bytes+28)/3), frame = exact outer JSON bytes

retransmit.timerStartsAt: transport write completion of that exact copy

room.sessionsCounted: authenticated remote sessions in activeSessions at admit time

selfResponse.classification: by the t field only; still matched exactly against pending requests afterwards

background.note: frames discarded unparsed in background presence mode count here only

handshakeProgressIs: any inbound transport bytes where the transport exposes them (Android BoundedDraft.translateFrame)
any locally completed snapshot validation step

backoff.formula: delayMs = floorMs + random * min(capMs - floorMs, spreadMs * 2^attempt); random uniform in [0,1]; attempt starts at 0, +1 after every scheduled reconnect, capped at attemptCap
resetWhen: first op-ack received in the current session
the session has been CONNECTED continuously for stableSessionMs

ios: NWPathMonitor interface type change while satisfied

reachability.whileConnected: network lost or default network changed -> liveness probe (ping) with pathChangeProbeTimeoutMs; failure = transport loss

stopThresholds.pausedState: PAUSED_ACTION_REQUIRED: socket closed, wantConnected false, room/keys/replay kept, issue shown with Retry; Retry or (if retryOnForeground) the next foreground return resets the counters and connects

none.covers: DNS, TCP, TLS, proxy failures and timeouts with no HTTP status

statusSource.android: Java-WebSocket handshake failure reason /Invalid status code received: (\d{3})/ when the socket never opened
statusSource.ios: (task.response as? HTTPURLResponse)?.statusCode when the task never opened

storage.retry: through pacer on the ack timeout schedule, consumes an attempt

opNackActions.unparseableNack: ignored (as today), the op stays pending on its ack timer

snapshot.ignoreNotNewer: authenticated record that does not beat local replay state (unchanged behaviour, not counted)
skippedRecordsAre: counted per category for the notice
snapshot.embeddedIdRule: 3.0.1: before the wire id is computed, the single object's embedded id must be a canonical 8-4-4-4-12 UUID: whole-string match of embeddedIdPattern, ASCII hex in either case, exactly 36 characters, no trimming. Anything else is skipUnsupported embedded_uuid_does_not_match_wire_id on both the snapshot and the live path, never a sync stop. The wire-id hasher refuses non-canonical input too (null, never lenient bytes). An accepted id is the local model id in lowercase (Android folds it; iOS keeps a UUID value). Every record the validator accepts must also pass the replay commit's own checks, so a validated record can never end in persistenceFailure. v3 senders keep sending lowercase

embeddedIdCases.note: what both apps send in v3 today (iOS GeoJSONExporter.wire, Android UUID.toString)
RFC 9562: case-insensitive on input. Accepted on both; Android folds the local id to lowercase so one object never gets two local ids
sync-android-2: 3.0.0 Android hashed it to the canonical wire id, then validRemote refused it and sync stopped for the room
32 non-hex chars: Character.digit gave -1 per nibble, a wire id an attacker can still compute
a regex $ that matches before a final newline must not let this through
Character.digit and Long.parseLong accept Unicode digits; ASCII only
java.util.UUID.fromString accepts this, the canonical form doesn't
canonical and accepted (a UUID like any other)

snapshot.embeddedIdCasesRule: build a validly sealed and signed v3 waypoint put whose GeoJSON feature id is embeddedId and whose outer id is the wire id of the 16 bytes outerWireIdFromBytesHex (HMAC(metadataKey, 'tacmap-wire-obj-v3\0' || bytes)); run it through the classifier and through the real manager on the snapshot path and as a live put

liveWindowResync.trigger: authenticated live put/del whose stamp beats local state but counter - roomHighWater > ADVANCE_WINDOW
liveWindowResync.whileCoolingDown: drop the frame (today's behaviour) and remember one pending resync
liveWindowResync.action: clean close + immediate reconnect, not counted as a failure, backoff untouched

timeFloorAppliesWhen: no persisted epoch for the local actor
helloEpoch.escalationAppliesWhen: previous connection closed 4014; multiplies the epoch that was rejected
helloEpoch.backgroundSpareBlockAppliesWhen: background presence is opted in for this v3 room at hello reservation time
helloEpoch.formula: next = max(persisted+1 (or 1), timeFloor if applicable, 2*rejected if 4014); persist next (+spare block if bg) before signing

replayFences.pruneRule: drop fence (actor, sd, kid) when the durable replay state has a session domain for that actor and it differs from sd

history.pruneWhen: a candidate document would exceed maxEncodedBytes

backgroundRecipient.rule: a remote session whose latest accepted presence advertises retention > 45 s is not chat-receiving
backgroundRecipient.roomSend: allowed, state stays Routed / Sent to room as today

foreground.moveThreshold: distance from last SENT fix > max(moveMinMetres, current horizontalAccuracy)
immediateTriggers: first frame of an authenticated session
presence config change (callsign, affiliation, echelon, function, isHQ)

background.bridgeFrameAtEntry: send one background-retention frame using the newest fix <= bridgeFixMaxAgeMs old

fencePersistence.rule: persist (all actors, one write, flag false) before exposing a counter >= persisted+stride; flush every flushMs while any counter differs; clean points write flag true; before the first acceptance after a flag-true write, write flag false

replayWritesMax.presence: at most one per flushMs in steady state

persistenceBatching.journalWritesMax: one per local store mutation event (all ids in that event)

wireIdIndex.build: once per room session after keys and stores are attached, one reusable HMAC instance
wireIdIndex.lookups: O(1) forward (localId -> wireId) and reverse (wireId -> localId); a reverse miss means no local object, never a scan

lifecycle.sessionEndsIff: the transition locks the mission-data key, engages App Lock, or detaches the mission stores

onPauseWithoutBackgroundPresence: keep manager, room, keys, replay state, chat binding
reconnect after stores attach on resume

onEntry: discarded frames count only against receiveBudget.background
background.acks: dropped with all other inbound frames; the foreground snapshot re-derives which ops landed

attemptAt: next presence send opportunity after a detected drop
reconnect.epoch: next unused spare from helloEpoch.backgroundSpareBlock, never a durable write
session: drain snapshot frames unparsed (fence + byte ceilings only)

pauseSurface.android: replace the FGS notification with a non-ongoing paused notification

v2.outboundId: 3.0.1 (owner decision, gap-v2-room-2x-interop-1/2): iOS sends uuidString (uppercase), exactly as shipped 2.x iOS did. Android sends the raw id it remembered for that state key (sticky once any accepted inbound record used a raw id with an uppercase letter), else its lowercase local id

outboundIdRules.ios: frame id, AAD and signature message = uuid.uuidString (uppercase). Every map (lastContent, versions, versionsBy, kindById, forcedLocalDiff, forcedLegacyDeletes, deliveries' localId, join suppression) stays keyed by the lowercase state key; only the wire id is uppercase
outboundIdRules.android: frame id, AAD and signature message = rememberedRawId[stateKey] ?: localId (lowercase). The local object keeps the lowercase id (unchanged)
outboundIdRules.remember: Android only: every inbound put or del that passes stateKey, beats, AEAD and signature (and, for a put, the embedded check), applied or not, records its raw id for the state key when the raw id contains an uppercase letter. A later lowercase record never replaces it. Kept for deleted objects too, so an undo re-creates under the same casing
outboundIdRules.persist: Android only: sealed per-room store (DEK-bound opaque filename like the replay and chat stores), loaded at v2 join before the first diff, written at most once per snapshot and once per live batch, capped at 10,000 entries (then it stops learning), removed with the room's other local stores. A lost or unreadable store only means lowercase sends until the next snapshot re-teaches it
outboundIdRules.upgradeFrom300: iOS 3.0.0 kept every v2 per-id map in memory (cleared on each v2 connect), so nothing on the device is keyed lowercase across the update. Relay records 3.0.0 iOS wrote under lowercase ids stay; 3.0.1 never deletes or rewrites a record because of its casing (a del under the other casing deletes the object on 2.x iOS). The next edit supersedes them under the uppercase id at a higher v
outboundIdRules.v3: unaffected: v3 wire ids are HMACs of the UUID bytes, embedded ids follow snapshot.embeddedIdRule

v2.verifyWith: the raw id string exactly as received (AAD and signature)
v2.tieBreak: apply iff (v, by) > (lastV, lastBy) with by compared as ASCII byte strings

outbound.note: iOS always sends uppercase, whoever created the object (2.x iOS did the same)
shipped 2.x Android drops uppercase, so Android-created objects stay lowercase (S3-01) until an uppercase id for them is accepted, e.g. after a 3.0.1 iOS edit
gap-v2-room-2x-interop-2: the edit goes out under the id 2.x iOS uses, so it doesn't echo-delete

sync_records_skipped_unsupported.en: Some synced objects use a format this version of TacMap can't display, so they were skipped (count: {1}). Update TacMap to see them.
sync_records_skipped_unsupported.de: Einige synchronisierte Objekte verwenden ein Format, das diese TacMap-Version nicht anzeigen kann, und wurden übersprungen (Anzahl: {1}). Aktualisiere TacMap, um sie zu sehen.

sync_records_skipped_unverified.en: Some synced objects failed verification and were ignored (count: {1}). Your other data is unaffected. If this keeps happening, create a new join code.
sync_records_skipped_unverified.de: Einige synchronisierte Objekte haben die Prüfung nicht bestanden und wurden ignoriert (Anzahl: {1}). Deine übrigen Daten sind nicht betroffen. Wenn das weiterhin passiert, erstelle einen neuen Beitrittscode.

sync_room_reset_suspected.en: The relay sent an older copy of this room than this device has already seen. The room may have been reset after a long idle period, or the relay may be misbehaving. If this keeps happening, create a new join code.
sync_room_reset_suspected.de: Das Relay hat einen älteren Stand dieses Raums gesendet, als dieses Gerät bereits kennt. Der Raum wurde möglicherweise nach langer Inaktivität zurückgesetzt, oder das Relay verhält sich fehlerhaft. Wenn das weiterhin passiert, erstelle einen neuen Beitrittscode.

sync_room_reset_changes_paused.en: This Unit Sync room was reset by the relay and can no longer accept changes from this device. Your map stays saved here, and positions and chat still work. Create a new join code and share it with your unit.
sync_room_reset_changes_paused.de: Dieser Unit-Sync-Raum wurde vom Relay zurückgesetzt und kann keine Änderungen von diesem Gerät mehr annehmen. Deine Karte bleibt hier gespeichert, Positionen und Chat funktionieren weiterhin. Erstelle einen neuen Beitrittscode und teile ihn mit deiner Einheit.

sync_object_too_large.en: An object is too large to sync and stays on this device only. Simplify it or split it into smaller parts to share it.
sync_object_too_large.de: Ein Objekt ist zu groß für die Synchronisierung und bleibt nur auf diesem Gerät. Vereinfache es oder zerlege es in kleinere Teile, um es zu teilen.

sync_relay_busy.en: The Unit Sync room or relay is busy. Retrying automatically in a few minutes.
sync_relay_busy.de: Der Unit-Sync-Raum oder das Relay ist ausgelastet. Neuer Versuch automatisch in einigen Minuten.

sync_relay_rate_limited.en: The relay is limiting new connections from this network. Retrying automatically in about a minute.
sync_relay_rate_limited.de: Das Relay begrenzt neue Verbindungen aus diesem Netzwerk. Neuer Versuch automatisch in etwa einer Minute.

sync_room_full_cannot_join.en: This Unit Sync room is full and can't add this device. Ask your unit to delete unused objects, or create a new join code. Tap Retry to try again.
sync_room_full_cannot_join.de: Dieser Unit-Sync-Raum ist voll und kann dieses Gerät nicht aufnehmen. Bitte deine Einheit, nicht benötigte Objekte zu löschen, oder erstelle einen neuen Beitrittscode. Tippe auf „Erneut versuchen“, um es noch einmal zu versuchen.

sync_relay_refused_room.en: The relay refused this room. Check that TacMap is up to date and the join code is correct, then tap Retry.
sync_relay_refused_room.de: Das Relay hat diesen Raum abgelehnt. Prüfe, ob TacMap aktuell und der Beitrittscode korrekt ist, und tippe dann auf „Erneut versuchen“.

sync_identity_rejected.en: The relay rejected this device's signed Unit Sync identity, so sync stopped. Leave the room and join again. If it keeps happening, create a new join code.
sync_identity_rejected.de: Das Relay hat die signierte Unit-Sync-Identität dieses Geräts abgelehnt, daher wurde die Synchronisierung beendet. Verlasse den Raum und tritt erneut bei. Wenn das weiterhin passiert, erstelle einen neuen Beitrittscode.

sync_session_conflict.en: Another session with this device's Unit Sync identity keeps replacing this one. Close TacMap on any other copy of this device, then tap Retry.
sync_session_conflict.de: Eine andere Sitzung mit der Unit-Sync-Identität dieses Geräts ersetzt diese immer wieder. Schließe TacMap auf allen anderen Kopien dieses Geräts und tippe dann auf „Erneut versuchen“.

sync_session_counter_behind.en: The relay keeps rejecting this device's session counter after a storage reset, so sync stopped. Create a new join code for your unit.
sync_session_counter_behind.de: Das Relay lehnt den Sitzungszähler dieses Geräts nach einem Speicher-Reset weiterhin ab, daher wurde die Synchronisierung beendet. Erstelle einen neuen Beitrittscode für deine Einheit.

sync_snapshot_malformed_stopped.en: The relay keeps sending a malformed room snapshot, so sync stopped. No unverified data was used. Check the relay, then tap Retry.
sync_snapshot_malformed_stopped.de: Das Relay sendet wiederholt einen fehlerhaften Raum-Datenstand, daher wurde die Synchronisierung beendet. Ungeprüfte Daten wurden nicht verwendet. Prüfe das Relay und tippe dann auf „Erneut versuchen“.

sync_background_paused.en: Background location sharing paused at {1} because the connection was lost. Open TacMap to resume.
sync_background_paused.de: Die Standortfreigabe im Hintergrund wurde um {1} pausiert, weil die Verbindung verloren ging. Öffne TacMap, um fortzufahren.

chat_recipient_in_background.en: That unit's TacMap is in the background and can't receive chat until it is opened again.
chat_recipient_in_background.de: TacMap dieser Einheit läuft im Hintergrund und kann erst wieder Chatnachrichten empfangen, wenn die App geöffnet wird.

chat_replay_table_full.en: A message from a new unit session was blocked because this room's chat replay protection is full. Create a new join code to keep chatting with new sessions.
chat_replay_table_full.de: Eine Nachricht aus einer neuen Sitzung einer Einheit wurde blockiert, weil der Wiedergabeschutz des Chats in diesem Raum voll ist. Erstelle einen neuen Beitrittscode, um weiter mit neuen Sitzungen zu chatten.

sp4Deferred: resume from seq / delta snapshots (S1-07, S5-06b, S6-12)
egress-only / quiet subscription for background sockets (S2-08, S5-07, S6-05)
chat-key revoke frame so a backgrounded peer stops being a chat route (S6-04 relay half)
presence-only join that skips the snapshot (S2-07 relay half)
relay reporting its stored hello epoch on 4014 (S2-11, S3-11 relay half)
relay acking same-stamp resend as duplicate (S3-15 relay half)
not resending own tombstones older than TOMBSTONE_TTL_MS / treating seq as non-rolling (needs a retention capability)
relay batch-put frame or retryable rate nack (S6-07 relay half)

steps.frame: op-nack stale retry:false for A's rid

items: W2 with ct replaced by base64(64 random bytes)
W3 kind 'route' validly sealed and signed

fixes.position: east of start by speed*t metres, lon offset = metres / (111320 * cos(lat))
